utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I know I'm late to the convo—did I miss anything about what time we're meeting on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Saturday morning at the community center, Dane. Tess just told me Gus is lending tools, so we're all set there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh perfect, sounds like we've got a solid crew. I'll bring that old drill of mine, just gotta find it first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know where we're supposed to gather for the repair drive? I want to be sure I'm heading to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's at the community center on Maple Street! Gus mentioned they're meeting there Saturday morning bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Maple Street community center. And just to confirm, what time should we be there Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so you're both saying it's a real repair drive? Just double-checking.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely a real repair drive, Kira! I've been telling Oren and Ira every day—Saturday at the community center, don't forget your broken items!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, alright, I believe you! So Saturday at the community center—what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm glad to hear so many folks are helping out. I'd love to contribute, but I'm still getting my bearings around here—could you use an extra pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Nell! Vik's always happy to have more help. You could swing by his garage Saturday morning — he'll put you to work, I'm sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Saturday morning, got it. I'll be there—thanks for pointing me in the right direction, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Pia, that repair drive — did I miss it? I was supposed to bring my old toaster, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, you haven't missed it — we're still sorting out the schedule. I'm a bit worried we might not have all the tools we need, though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I could bring some spare tools! I think I've got a wrench set somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's a neighborhood event where we fix broken items for free—like appliances, bikes, and electronics—to reduce waste and help each other out. I'm really excited to pitch in!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, I see. That sounds helpful. I'll bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Uli! A toaster should be easy to fix. I'll make sure we have the right tools on hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I've got a bunch of spare wrenches and screwdrivers I could lend out. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Gus! I'll be sorting donated tools on Saturday morning — bring them by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Sam! I'll load up my truck and see you there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Jules, quick update—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. I hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Sunday works even better for me! I'll round up a few folks from the east block — they've been asking about ways to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Jules! I'll update the flyers and let Noah know about the change too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, just double-checking—are we still on for 10 at the community center? I've got the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, 10 works. Got the shovels and rakes loaded up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll see you at 10 with the sign-up sheet. Thanks for bringing the tools!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, no idea. Maybe ask Cleo—she seems to know everything around here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe I'll catch Cleo later then—I was just curious about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds good. Gotta run!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So we're finally getting that repair drive organized — what exactly are we fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure yet—Pia's confirming the tools and parts, but I'll be there at 9 AM sharp to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: And where exactly is this all happening? I don't want to show up at the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Noah, about that repair drive — is it for the community computer system or something else? Just want to be sure I understand before we jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! No, no, it's more like squeaky doors and broken fences—small neighborhood fixes. Sorry, I keep forgetting the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, got it! So it's all the little things that need some elbow grease. Where do we start?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, folks. I grabbed a couple spare hinges from my garage—figured they might come in handy for those fence gates.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Dane—are you sure this is a repair drive? I could've sworn I heard something about a yard sale.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No, Kira, it's definitely a repair drive. We're fixing fences, not selling stuff. Maybe you mixed it up with something else?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, you're just the person I needed to see! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 a.m. — can we count you in?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh yeah, I heard about it from Mrs. Henderson. I was actually planning to swing by the hardware store later to grab some supplies Vik mentioned. You can definitely count me in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic! Vik will be thrilled to hear you're on board with the supplies too — I'll spread the word that you're our go-to person for that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh Mina, you're asking about that repair drive? Right, right—I did say I'd organize it. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly is the repair drive for? I want to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Rosa mentioned it's for small stuff like squeaky doors and broken fences. That's the gist of it, I think.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did we remember to pack extra batteries for the power tools? I'd hate for them to die on us mid-repair.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, good thinking, Pia. I packed a fresh set in the big tool box, so we should be set. Let me double-check, though.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks Cleo. And what about the socket wrench set? I remember we had a missing piece last time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Leo! Good to see you. That repair drive... is it this weekend or next? I keep mixing up my days.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: This Saturday, at 10.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right! Saturday at 10. I better start looking for that toaster — I think it's in the back of the hall closet, behind the holiday decorations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring along my multimeter too, in case anyone needs to test electrical stuff like that lamp of yours.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful, Gus! Perfect timing too since we've moved it to Sunday at the community center — more space for everyone to spread out and work.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sunday works even better for me, Rosa — I'll bring my toolbox and that multimeter first thing in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm pretty good with a paintbrush, if you still need help with the benches.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Rey! We could definitely use a hand with the benches. I'll bring my paint supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I'll be there Saturday morning then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, are you helping with the repair drive? I was just talking to Noah about rounding up some people.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh Jules, yes! Can you help too? Sam's already on board for Saturday morning to sort tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help! Maybe I could reach out to Hana too—she mentioned the swing set chains being frayed, so she might have some input.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the repair drive? What's that about again? I'm in a rush.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's for fixing up the playground equipment—the swing set chains are frayed. Are you able to help out?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the playground. I think I have an old drill in the garage. What time did you say this was happening?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Saturday at 9 AM. I'll be there to help organize the tools. Do we have a list of what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the list, but I heard Vik's been gathering tools — maybe check with him?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea, I'll ask Vik for the list. Thanks, Nell.
